==Notes==
*In [[PvP]], this skill has the shortest recharge time amongst all off-hand attacks which follow a lead attack (as [[Fox Fangs (PvP)]] and [[Wild Strike (PvP)]] have increased recharge times and both [[Repeating Strike]] and [[Moebius Strike]] cannot be used after a lead attack).

== Trivia ==
* This is one of two "off-hand" attacks where in the [[skill icon]] the assassin is clearly attacking with his right hand instead of his left.
